about: The communio of the formulary “Second Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The Lord saith: Fill the waterpots with water and bear unto the chief steward of the feast. When the chief steward had tasted the water made wine, he said unto the bridegroom: Thou hast kept the good wine until now. This sign Jesus wrought first before His disciples.
